emails.subject: Payday Sale: funding with Barkley & Co
emails.body:
Hi Anil,

For the sale we would like Barkley & Co to fund 50.5% of the markdown on the SKUs we are promoting, worth ₹18,657.

Could you confirm by Friday?

Thanks

emails.subject: Payday Sale: funding with Purrline Foods
emails.body:
Hi Rakesh,

Thank you for the offer. It is worth ₹9,434 to us, 39.6% of the ₹23,800 we asked for on those SKUs. Could you raise the share to 50.5% of the markdown?

Could you confirm by Friday?

Thanks
